newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB raises US$1 billion in issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB raises US$1 billion in issue.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Thursday it had successfully raised US$1 billion from a global offering of exchangeable capital units.
NAB said offering closed successfully, with the underwriters exercising an option to purchase an additional five million units to cover over-allotments.
This increased the total offering to 40 million units from the 35 million announced last week, it said in a statement.
The exchangeable capital units (excaps), rated A-plus by Standard & Poor's and A-1 by Moody's Investors Service, were not offered or listed in Australia.

The excaps consist of US$25 principal amount of 7-7/8 percent perpetual capital security, and the ability to convert the excaps into either NAB ordinary shares at the rate of 1.637 shares per excap, a cash equivalent, or non-cumulative preference shares on a one-for-one basis.
The offering was made through a United States underwriting syndicate led by Merrill Lynch as lead manager and Morgan Stanley as co-manager.
